nodes.name: NF Cleaning
nodes.procedure: To remove the nickel oxides on the NF surface, the NF was soaked in 1 M HCl solution firstly, then washed with deionized water, acetone and ethanol in turns. The NF was dried in a vacuum oven to avoid reoxidation.

nodes.name: Am-Mo-NiS0.5Se0.5 Solvothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.288 g selenium powder was firstly dissolved in 10 mL hydrazine hydrate with stirring for 30 min. Then 0.278 g thiourea, 0.6 g ammonium fluoride, 10 ml ethanol and 10 mL water were added. After stirring for 30 min, 0.144 g molybdenum oxide was added. Then after stirring for another 30 min, 0.002 g sodium borohydride was added into the solution and stirred slowly for 30 min. The obtained solution with a dried NF (1 × 2.5 cm²) was put into a 50 ml Teflon-lined stainless autoclave to process the solvothermal reaction at 200 °C for 24 h. After the solvothermal process, the autoclave was cooled by water, and the obtained Am-Mo-NiS0.5Se0.5 was washed with DI water for three times then frozen drying. The dried samples are stored in a vacuum drying oven to prevent oxidation.

nodes.name: Cr-Mo-NiS0.5Se0.5 Solvothermal + Crystallization
nodes.procedure: 0.288 g selenium powder was firstly dissolved in 6 mL hydrazine hydrate with stirring for 30 min. Then 0.278 g thiourea, 0.4 g ammonium fluoride, 15 mL ethanol and 9 mL water were added. After stirring for 30 min, 0.144 g molybdenum oxide was added. After stirring for another 30 min, the obtained solution with a dried NF (1 × 2.5 cm²) was put into a 50 mL Teflon-lined stainless autoclave to process the solvothermal reaction at 200 °C for 24 h. After the solvothermal process, the autoclave was cooled to room temperature following the furnace. The obtained sample was washed with DI water for three times then frozen drying. The synthesized black foam was heated at 200 °C for 6h in Ar atmosphere in the tube furnace, obtained the crystalline Cr-Mo-NiS0.5Se0.5. The dried samples are stored in a vacuum drying oven to prevent oxidation.
